criteria_verification.notes: Independent tests confirm keycloak role exists with LOGIN capability, NOSUPERUSER status, and NOCREATEDB/NOCREATEROLE restrictions. Database exists and is owned by keycloak role. TestKeycloakRoleCreation class (6 tests) all passed.
TestIdempotency class confirms second application succeeds and skips creation. Tests verify pg_roles and pg_database guards prevent duplicate creation errors.
TestPasswordFromVariable confirms no hardcoded passwords in SQL file and verifies role has password set. Uses :kc_password variable per documentation.

TestLeastPrivilegeIsolation (5 tests) validates symmetric isolation: keycloak cannot access study_tutor, study_tutor cannot access keycloak, each can access own database, and negative proof test confirms connection failure.
TestNamingContract validates exact 'keycloak' naming for both role and database, matching §4 KEYCLOAK_DB contract.
TestSQLFormat validates SQL file exists, is readable, has comprehensive documentation header, and documents least-privilege proof. All format validation tests passed.
